template.name: template_tribe_context_alert
template.event:
local showTribalAlert = (game.numIslands() > 1 or game.playerLevel() >= 10) and (game.newTribalInviteNotice() or game.newTribalRequestNotice()) local showColdIslandAlert = game.playerLevel() >= 6 and not game.isIslandOwned(2) and game.playerCanAffordIsland(2)
--print("Show Tribal Alert?", showTribalAlert) --print("Show Cold Island Alert?", showColdIslandAlert)
if( showTribalAlert or showColdIslandAlert) then element["Indicator"]:Show() else element["Indicator"]:Hide() end
